steps.title: Find the center contact
steps.text: The coil feed meets the cap's central contact, which bears on the raised rotor leaf. The cap contact remains an estimated envelope; its hidden attachment and material are unresolved.

steps.title: Follow the separate leaf
steps.text: The curved leaf rotates with the rotor and meets the captured outer conductor. The exact1994 service procedure names a rotor blade and spring, and Ford's current DR375A photo shows the folded leaf. The model does not infer a coil spring inside the cap.

steps.title: Reach the outer tip
steps.text: The conductor leads toward the peripheral tip. Existing terminal indexing, gap and timing are educational estimates, not a wiring or calibration guide.

troubleshooting.title: Understand a lost contact
troubleshooting.text: A deliberately lowered leaf opens the modeled center connection; a raised leaf intersects it. These geometric checks explain contact loss but do not measure voltage, resistance, spring force or ignition performance.

distributor-rotor-center-leaf.limits: Rotor-only source-compared topology. Dimensions, bend radii, alloy, preload and molded stake details are inferred; cap brush construction remains open.

distributor-rotor.summary: Separate insulation from the contact path

steps.title: Inspect the collar and recess
steps.text: The molded collar surrounds the raised metal leaf, with an opening toward the outer pad. Its dimensions are estimated from replacement-photo topology.

steps.title: Inspect the captured pad
steps.text: An illustrative integral stake holds the conductor over the leaf foot. The photo supports a captured pad; the exact manufacturing joint is unknown.

distributor-rotor.limits: Shaft seat is preserved from the existing model; production seating dimensions and dielectric performance are not verified.

steps.title: Trace center to tip
steps.text: The separate raised leaf meets this captured conductor, which keeps the existing peripheral-tip position.

distributor-rotor-contact.limits: Materials, joint resistance, terminal indexing and operating spark gap are unverified.
